summary: _wedge_failover re-reads the mutable sidecar without asserting handle.pod_name==info.name; a poller respawn re-pointing it to a FRESH pod mid-tick makes the watcher terminate a healthy fresh pod
evidence: scripts/autonomous_session_watch.py:3238-3247 (re-reads via resolve_handle_sidecar_path+read_handle_sidecar, no info-identity bind) then _failover_wedged_runpod terminates get_pod_by_name(handle.pod_name) (backend_poll.py:1099-1101); bounded-once guard keyed on the FRESH handle identity (backend_poll.py:891-901), so the old wedge stamp won't match and a fresh pod has none. Fix: assert handle.pod_name==info.name before failover, else return already-handled. High cost (kills live work + re-triggers billing leak)
